fields.cwd: bridge runPoint(): workingDirectory.ensure/get session directory; synthetic C:/repo
fields.tool_name: bridge preToolPayload/postToolPayload(): exec.name, no Claude alias conversion
fields.tool_input.command: bash and pwsh tool parameter schema
fields.tool_input.description: bash and pwsh required description parameter
fields.tool_input.workdir: bash and pwsh optional workdir resolves against session cwd
fields.tool_input.file_path: write/edit parameter schemas; filesystem backend path, not necessarily local
fields.tool_response: bridge blocksToText(result.content); write formatWriteOutput/edit formatEditOutput; loses isError and canonical value, never used as success evidence
fields.observer.result.isError: pipeline notifyResult(): final frozen result; errors also receive post-execute
fields.observer.result.value.path: write/edit canonical successful result; observer uses it only with isError exactly false
fields.observer.local: fs.processPathFromHostPath contract promises same file; both observer ctx.fs and exec.agent.ctx.fs are checked; SSH returns undefined
fields.observer.version,agent,event,host_event,: Obituary BridgeRequest v1, generated by plugins/deepseek/index.ts; tools/result is observation-only

fixtures.deepseek-ssh.json: bridge + ssh, remote /mnt/c deliberately resembles WSL; must not map to this machine

limits: No actual host installed or run; source-based compatibility only.
Official bridge lacks execution locality, actual shell dialect and structured write success.
OBIT_DEEPSEEK_LOCAL and OBIT_DEEPSEEK_SHELL are operator attestations, never payload arguments.
Native observer supplements only successful write/edit observations; context and deny retain the official bridge.
No SessionEnd. SessionStart can miss the first request/write.
Profile/home/CLI overlay ordering and entire-config replacement require explicit activation and host verification.
